# Analysis of Ghana data using hptest

## Prerequisites

Before reaching this point, genotype data was converted to VCF format and to BGEN format.  These data reside in:
* `results/bgen/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.bgen` and
* `results/vcf/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.vcf.gz`

For PC computation, a 'fake diploid' version of the input vcf file was also created, in `results/vcf/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.fakediploid.vcf.gz`.
This makes all samples diploid with homozygous genotypes, and is so that the `qctool -kinship` option works.

Sample information was converted to the QCTOOL/SNPTEST-style `.sample` format, and should reside in `data/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.sample`.

The main results were then generated using the pipeline in the `pipeline` folder.

## Prerequisites

The code below relies on tidyverse, which must be installed first:
```
library( dplyr )
library( tibble )

echo = function( message, ... ) {
	cat( sprintf( message, ... ))
}
```

We specify main and 'strict' sample set analyses as follows:
```r
analyses = list(
	main = 'thin=100bp-r=0.5',
	strict = 'thin=100bp-r=0.2'
)
```

## Loading data:

We start by loading samples, PCs, and host and parasite genotypes for analysis:

```r
echo( "++ Loading data...\n" )
samples = list(
	main   = readr::read_table( sprintf( "results/samples/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.PCs-%s.sample", analyses$main ))[-1,] %>% filter( !is.na( PC_1 )),
	strict = readr::read_table( sprintf( "results/samples/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.PCs-%s.sample", analyses$strict ))[-1,] %>% filter( !is.na( PC_1 ))
)
genotypes = list(
	hbb = readr::read_tsv( pipe( "gunzip -c results/vcf/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples_hbb_genotypes.vcf.gz | grep -v '^##'" ))
)
hbb = as.matrix( genotypes$hbb[,10:ncol(genotypes$hbb)])
rownames(hbb) = genotypes$hbb$ID

samples$main$rs334 = hbb['rs334', samples$main$sample_roma_id ]
samples$main$rs33930165 = hbb['rs33930165', samples$main$sample_roma_id ]
samples$strict$rs334 = hbb['rs334', samples$strict$sample_roma_id ]
samples$strict$rs33930165 = hbb['rs33930165', samples$strict$sample_roma_id ]

G = rbgen::bgen.load( "results/bgen/ghana_2015_study_1555_samples.bgen", ranges = tibble::tibble(
	chromosome = sprintf( "Pf3D7_%02d_v3", c( 2, 11, 4 )),
	start = c( 631190, 1058035, 1121472 ),
	end = c( 631190, 1058035, 1121472 )
))
G$dosage = G$data[,,2]

samples$main$Pfsa1 = G$dosage[ 'Pf3D7_02_v3_631190', samples$main$sample_roma_id ]
samples$main$Pfsa3 = G$dosage[ 'Pf3D7_11_v3_1058035', samples$main$sample_roma_id ]
samples$main$Pfsa4 = G$dosage[ 'Pf3D7_04_v3_1121472', samples$main$sample_roma_id ]
samples$main$pfsa = gsub( "0", "-", gsub( "1", "+", sapply( 1:nrow( samples$main ), function(i) {
	sprintf( "%s %s %s", samples$main$Pfsa1[i], samples$main$Pfsa3[i], 1 - samples$main$Pfsa4[i] )
})))
```

## Computation of sample counts for main text:
```r
echo( "++ Main analysis sample counts:\n" )
addmargins( table( samples$main$eurofins_final_Hb_call, samples$main$rs334 ) )
echo( "++ Strict analysis sample counts:\n" )
addmargins( table( samples$strict$eurofins_final_Hb_call, samples$strict$rs334 ) )
```


## Loading association results:

```
library( RSQLite )
library( tibble )
results = tibble()
for( name in names(analyses) ) {
	analysis = analyses[[name]]
	db = dbConnect( dbDriver( "SQLite" ), sprintf( "results/hptest/hptest-%s.sqlite", analysis ))
	X = dplyr::bind_cols(
		tibble(
			analysis_type = name,
			analysis_detail = analysis
		),
		as_tibble(
			dbGetQuery( db, "SELECT * FROM ResultView WHERE predictor_rsid == 'rs334' AND outcome_position IN ( 1121472, 631190, 1058035 )" )
		)
	)
	results = dplyr::bind_rows(
		results,
		X %>% select(
			`analysis_type`,
			`analysis_detail`,
			`analysis`,
			`predictor_rsid`,
			`outcome_chromosome`,
			`outcome_position`,
			`N`,
			`missing`,
			`outcome=0`,
			`outcome=1`,
			`predictor=0`,
			`predictor=1`,
			`predictor=2`,
			`minimum_outcome_count`,
			`minimum_predictor_count`,
			`minimum_expected_predictor_allele_count`,
			`minimum_expected_predictor_allele_count_genotype`,
			`add:converged`,
			`add:iterations`,
			`add:fit_time`,
			`add:ll`,
			`add:beta_1:add/outcome=1`,
			`add:sd_1`,
			`add:log10_bf`,
			`add:se_1`,
			`add:pvalue_1`,
			`dom:converged`,
			`dom:iterations`,
			`dom:fit_time`,
			`dom:ll`,
			`dom:beta_1` = `dom:beta_1:dom/outcome=1`,
			`dom:sd_1`,
			`dom:log10_bf`,
			`dom:prior_mode_1`,
			`dom:se_1`,
			`dom:pvalue_1`,
			`comment`
		) %>% mutate(
			bf = sprintf( "%.3g", 10^`dom:log10_bf` ),
			pvalue = sprintf( "%.3g", `dom:pvalue_1` ),
			OR = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) ),
			lower = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) - 1.96 * `dom:se_1` ),
			upper = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) + 1.96 * `dom:se_1` ),
			interval = sprintf( "%.2f (%.2f - %.2f)", OR, lower, upper )
		)
	)
}
```

## Numbers for main association paragraphs:
```r
print(
	results %>% select(
		analysis_detail, analysis, predictor_rsid, outcome_chromosome, outcome_position,
		`bf`, `pvalue`, `dom:log10_bf`, `dom:pvalue_1`, `interval`, `dom:beta_1`, `dom:se_1`
	) %>% filter(
		(analysis_detail == 'thin=100bp-r=0.5' & analysis %in% c( 'samples=qcd:pcs=5', 'samples=qcd:pcs=2' ))
		| (analysis_detail == 'thin=100bp-r=0.2' & analysis == 'samples=qcd:pcs=2')
	),
	width = 1000,
	n = 50
)
```

## Computation of Pfsa join genotype counts:
```r
(
	samples$main
	%>% filter( !is.na( Pfsa1 ) & !is.na( Pfsa4 ) & !is.na( Pfsa3 ))
	%>% group_by( (rs334 %in% c( "0/1", "1/1" )), pfsa )
	%>% count()
)
```


## Inspection of HbC analysis:
```r
echo( "++ Main analysis HbC sample counts:\n" )
addmargins( table( samples$main$eurofins_final_Hb_call, samples$main$rs33930165 )[c( "HbAA", "HbAC", "HbCC"), ] )
```

```r
library( RSQLite )
analysis = "thin=100bp-r=0.5"
db = dbConnect( dbDriver( "SQLite" ), sprintf( "results/hptest/hptest-%s.sqlite", analysis ))
HbC = (
	as_tibble(
		dbGetQuery( db, "SELECT RV.*, V.alleleA AS outcome_alleleA, V.alleleB AS outcome_alleleB FROM ResultView RV INNER JOIN Variant V ON V.id == RV.outcome_id WHERE predictor_rsid == 'rs33930165' AND analysis == 'samples=qcd:pcs=2:no-HbS'" )
	)
		%>% select(
		`analysis`,
		`predictor_rsid`,
		`outcome_chromosome`,
		`outcome_position`,
		`outcome_alleleA`,
		`outcome_alleleB`,
		`N`,
		`missing`,
		`outcome=0`,
		`outcome=1`,
		`predictor=0`,
		`predictor=1`,
		`predictor=2`,
		`minimum_outcome_count`,
		`minimum_predictor_count`,
		`minimum_expected_predictor_allele_count`,
		`minimum_expected_predictor_allele_count_genotype`,
		`add:converged`,
		`add:iterations`,
		`add:fit_time`,
		`add:ll`,
		`add:beta_1:add/outcome=1`,
		`add:sd_1`,
		`add:log10_bf`,
		`add:se_1`,
		`add:pvalue_1`,
		`dom:converged`,
		`dom:iterations`,
		`dom:fit_time`,
		`dom:ll`,
		`dom:beta_1` = `dom:beta_1:dom/outcome=1`,
		`dom:sd_1`,
		`dom:log10_bf`,
		`dom:prior_mode_1`,
		`dom:se_1`,
		`dom:pvalue_1`,
		`comment`
	) %>% mutate(
		bf = sprintf( "%.3g", 10^`dom:log10_bf` ),
		pvalue = sprintf( "%.3g", `dom:pvalue_1` ),
		OR = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) ),
		lower = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) - 1.96 * `dom:se_1` ),
		upper = exp( abs(`dom:beta_1`) + 1.96 * `dom:se_1` ),
		interval = sprintf( "%.2f (%.2f - %.2f)", OR, lower, upper )
	)
)

HbC %>% arrange( desc( `dom:log10_bf` ))
```
